title: Agent rail conversation list
description: Native-history conversations belonging to the rail's workspaces and places, including archived conversations and controller-only new conversations. Listing starts no Pi. History or archive read failure, or failed/partial workspace discovery, returns an error rather than a partial handle inventory.

lifecycle.description: Archived takes precedence; otherwise live means a running Pi was observed, resting means none was observed. This observation grants no control authority.

state.description: Controller state, present only when a handle exists.

startup_choice.description: Controller startup choice, present only when a handle exists; null means native defaults.
